templates.name: annotated scene (red circle or arrow, or black label)

constants: Pure real footage in 17 of 20. Composites with a cut-out vehicle or illustrated panel: 05, 06, 13.
No face in 19 of 20 (only 20 shows one). No logo, channel name or brand border on any thumbnail.
Every thumbnail with text uses capitals (5 of 5: 05, 06, 09, 13, 19).
No fixed typeface: heavy condensed sans (05, 09), wide grotesque sans (13, 19), brush display (06).
No fixed colour pair. Red is the only recurring accent: 06, 07, 10, 19 (4 of 20).
Black armoured vehicle recurs in 04, 06, 10, 19 (4 of 20). Storm-dark or dusk grade in 14, 15, 17.
Colours and hex values are visual estimates from the pixels, not sampled values.

host_treatment.when_present: Head and shoulders, close crop, left side, top to middle; face about 30 percent of frame width; not cut out; no outline or rim light; daylight; neutral to serious expression; looks at camera.
host_treatment.caveat: The channel's top 10 by views carry no face at all. The owner's face-first design is not supported by this channel's top thumbnails; the storm and the vehicle carry the click here. The face-led layout has one example (20, 146k views), so treat it as untested for this channel.

text_rules.presence: Text in 5 of 20 (05, 06, 09, 13, 19). 15 of 20 have none.
text_rules.colours: White with black outline (05, 13); black on pale sky, no outline (09); red (06 VS; 19 BROKE); white IT on black box (19).
text_rules.position: Top left (05), centre (06), left middle (09), top right (13), bottom right (19).
text_rules.highlight: Red on one word (19) or the whole word (06). Otherwise none; 09 uses its arrow as the highlight.
text_rules.size: Biggest line about 9 to 14 percent of frame height (05 14, 09 9, 13 10, 19 11); 06 VS about 40 percent.
text_rules.title_link: Repeats title in 05 (Tornado Tank) and echoes it in 06 (VS). Adds a second idea in 09 (HOME), 13 (BRING IT.) and 19 (IT BROKE).

popular_vs_latest.popular_1_to_10: Views 2.9M to 20M. Face 0 of 10. Text 3 of 10 (05, 06, 09). Red or black annotation 5 of 10 (hand 05, VS 06, circle 07, arrow 09, arrow 10). Tornado funnel or wall visible 6 of 10 (01, 02, 06, 07, 08, 09). Dominator-style vehicle 4 of 10 (04, 05, 06, 10).
popular_vs_latest.latest_11_to_20: Views 68k to 1M (13 has no count). Face 1 of 10 (20). Text 2 of 10 (13, 19). Annotation 1 of 10 (13 white circle). Funnel visible 3 of 10 (12, 14, 15). No tornado in frame 7 of 10 (11, 13, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20). Darker grades in 14, 15, 17.
popular_vs_latest.difference: The popular set shows the storm and a marked-up detail; the latest set shows aftermath, floods and dark skies with little annotation. The thumbnails differ in visible tornado and annotation, not in face use, which is zero in both groups except one. Views differ about 100 times, so thumbnails alone do not explain the gap; video age and topic also matter.

top3.shared: All three are real footage with no face, no text and no logo. 01 and 02 show tornadoes at full scale, 02 with a town being hit. 03 is a drone shot of a mud flow with no tornado, so the top-view thumbnails do not require a tornado; they require a large, legible disaster scene. 01 adds a torn grunge frame, the only frame treatment in the top 3.

transfer.rule: Open on real storm footage that fills the frame with the storm, with a funnel or wall clearly visible.
transfer.evidence: 6 of the top 10 show a funnel or wall (01, 02, 06, 07, 08, 09); the top two (01, 02) show tornadoes on the ground. Latest 10: 3 show a funnel (12, 14, 15).

transfer.rule: Put one red mark on one detail of the storm: a circle, an arrow or a versus badge.
transfer.evidence: Popular 5 of 10 carry a red or black mark (05 hand, 06 VS, 07 red circle, 09 arrow, 10 red arrow). Latest 1 of 10 (13 white circle).

transfer.rule: Keep any text to one or two words in capitals, white with black outline or on a solid box, placed in a corner.
transfer.evidence: All text thumbnails: 05 TORNADO TANK, 06 VS, 09 HOME, 13 BRING IT., 19 IT BROKE. All capitals, all 1 or 2 words, all corner or edge placed except 06.

transfer.rule: Place the presenter at the storm's edge, not the middle, with the storm filling the other side of the frame.
transfer.evidence: Vehicle at the edge with the storm on the other side in 04 (lower left, storm top right), 06 (left, tornado right) and 10 (lower centre, dust right). Only 20 puts a person in close-up, and that frame has no storm to share.

transfer.rule: Show the result of the storm in one frame and pair it with a short outcome word.
transfer.evidence: 02 shows a town hit (11M). 19 shows a burning vehicle with IT BROKE (888k). 16 shows an upturned car (110k).

weak.why: Dim, grainy night frame with a faint funnel. No text, no mark, no subject to hold the eye. 106k views.
Dark teal sky and letterbox bars with no readable tornado. The title says the tornado was intercepted, but the frame shows no funnel. 236k views.
Silver pickup in brown floodwater. No tornado in frame although the title names one, and the vehicle has no Dominator livery. 104k views.
